title: skill-quality team config
description: Schema for a repository's <home>/skill-quality.yaml, the team layer of the skill-quality plugin's settings, and its personal override <home>/skill-quality.local.yaml. Read by scripts/check-skill.sh check 30 (description keys) and scripts/measure-invocation.sh emit-plugin-eval (plugin_eval_runs). Contract: docs/contracts/config-cascade/README.md.

description_target.description: A skill description longer than this many characters prints an INFO line.

description_warn.description: A skill description longer than this many characters warns. The 1,024-character field maximum stays a fixed FAIL.

plugin_eval_runs.description: Runs per case that measure-invocation.sh emit-plugin-eval writes into each emitted claude plugin eval case. A --runs flag beats it.
